section: Hero: a sand panel with the title, standfirst and byline, beside a large photograph
fields: Title (the page title at the top of the editor)
Insight box, below the title: Title highlight
notes: Title highlight is the part of the title shown in coral. Type it exactly as it appears in the title. If it is empty, the whole title stays dark.
The sentence under the title is the Excerpt. If the Excerpt is empty, the first 32 words of the article are used instead.
The byline says "Written by" and shows the WordPress author with their profile picture. The Host field on the Insight box is only used for events and podcasts.
Up to three Topics appear as links beside the date. The read time is worked out for you from the length of the article.
The Featured image sits beside the title, with a coral circle over its corner. Use a landscape photograph at least 1200 pixels wide.
Write in short sections and use Heading 2 for each main section and Heading 3 for sub-sections. Heading 2s build the On this page list.
Paragraphs, lists, quotes and images are normal editor blocks. Add the Image block from the Crucible blocks when you want a wide or full width image with a caption.

section: Stats, video, gallery and banner blocks inside the text
fields: Add block, then Crucible blocks: Stat
Add block, then Crucible blocks: Video
Add block, then Crucible blocks: Gallery (choose the Pair layout for articles)
Add block, then Crucible blocks: Banner
Add block, then Crucible blocks: Image
notes: Stat shows one to three big figures with a caption and an optional Source link.
Video takes a YouTube or Vimeo link and an optional cover image and caption. Nothing from YouTube or Vimeo loads until the visitor presses play.
Gallery in the Pair layout shows one or two photographs side by side. Tick Show captions to show the caption from the media library.
Banner has two styles: Image and text (sand), good for a link to a related article, and Text only (coral) for a short call-out with links.

fields: Add block, then Crucible blocks: FAQ
FAQ block: Layout, Title, Intro text, Questions come from, Questions
notes: The FAQ block adds its title to the end of the On this page list, so you do not need a separate heading above it.
Choose Type them here to write two to six questions in the block, or choose FAQ posts to reuse the shared questions.
Keep Output FAQ schema on only when these are real, public FAQs.

section: Sidebar: On this page and the timeline form
fields: Built automatically from the Heading 2s in the article
notes: The list follows the reader down the page. There is nothing to fill in.
The "Get a timeline for your project" form below it is the same on every article and is set up in the form settings.

section: Related insights and the closing call to action
notes: Three other insights that share a Topic with this one are shown automatically. Giving every article at least one Topic makes this work well.
The dark "Interested in working with us?" band at the bottom is a shared pattern and is the same on every article.
